principles: Change only what a user reads (prose + user-facing strings), never a load-bearing identifier
Phase the rebrand so no single story can break the build, audit trail, or evidence verification
Brand-first is the lowest-risk starting point
drivers: 18k lattice hits are mostly internal identifiers; blind rename is catastrophic
the .lattice/ dir is self-referential (the workflow uses it) so it must be a separate late phase

options.name: Phase-1 user-visible branding only (keep all identifiers)
cons: docs temporarily mix Proofbound brand with lattice commands until Phase 3

options.name: Big-bang full Lattice->Proofbound rename
cons: breaks build + .lattice audit dir + @lattice packages + signed evidence

options.name: Direct mechanical commit (no Lattice)
cons: Phase 1 edits packages/*/src strings = code, so it goes through Lattice

chosen: Phase-1 user-visible branding only (keep all identifiers)
rationale: Lowest-risk, high user-visible value, zero load-bearing-identifier collateral; the phased program isolates the dangerous .lattice-dir rename to a separate late phase.

preMortem.scenario: over-reach into identifiers breaks the build
preMortem.trigger: a blind sed also changes lowercase `lattice` commands / .lattice paths / @lattice imports / schema-ids / salts
preMortem.consequence: build/tests fail or audit-trail/evidence verification breaks
preMortem.mitigation: replace only the capitalized brand word Lattice in prose/strings; keep lowercase identifiers; grep-verify the lattice binary, @lattice packages, .lattice paths, schema-ids and salts are byte-unchanged after the sweep

preMortem.scenario: docs mix Proofbound brand with lattice commands and confuse readers
preMortem.trigger: Phase 1 renames the brand but keeps the lattice binary until Phase 3
preMortem.consequence: a doc says Proofbound CLI but shows `lattice validate`
preMortem.mitigation: acceptable and documented in the CHANGELOG (phased rebrand); Phase 3 renames the binary

preMortem.scenario: a brand string embedded in a code identifier gets changed
preMortem.trigger: Lattice appears inside a TypeScript identifier or type name in src
preMortem.mitigation: the full test suite (tsc build) catches it; restrict src edits to string literals / comments / --help text, not identifiers
